title: Ese lead nunca contestó: lo que tu director comercial no ve (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 9)

ia.dice: A ver, asesores inmobiliarios: de los leads de ayer, ¿qué pasó con el del penthouse?
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Warm office lighting, a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops, coffee mugs and printed charts. Fabián, the sales director of a real estate agency, a Mexican man in his forties with a neatly trimmed beard, square black glasses and a fitted navy blazer over a black turtleneck, stands at the head of the table holding a tablet, serious, looks over his glasses at the real estate agents sitting around the table and says in Mexican Spanish, firm and direct: "A ver, asesores inmobiliarios: de los leads de ayer, ¿qué pasó con el del penthouse?" Medium shot, slow push-in. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Ese lead nunca contestó, jefe. Ya lo di por perdido.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Warm office lighting, a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops, coffee mugs and printed charts. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, sits at the table leaning back in his chair, totally relaxed, shrugs and spins a pen and says in Mexican Spanish, casual and convincing: "Ese lead nunca contestó, jefe. Ya lo di por perdido." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: ¡Felicidades por su penthouse, señora! Mañana firmamos… pero en la otra oficina.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, inside a parked car right outside a real estate agency office with a big "AGENCIA INMOBILIARIA" sign. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, holds the phone to his ear, very happy, then winks at the camera and says in Mexican Spanish, cheerful and overly friendly, the last words whispered: "¡Felicidades por su penthouse, señora! Mañana firmamos… pero en la otra oficina." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet street ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Tu director comercial no puede leer el WhatsApp de cada asesor. Si le dicen «no contestó», tiene que creerles. Aunque el lead sí contestó… y compró en otro lado.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
